summary: Niki BioSolutions, Inc. filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026 disclosing entry into an At the Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC and Brookline Capital Markets as sales agents. The company may sell common stock having an aggregate maximum offering price of up to $1,396,000 from time to time at prevailing market prices under Rule 415. The ATM prospectus supplement forms part of a Form S-3 shelf registration statement filed August 28, 2026 and declared effective October 9, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for dilution and any actual share sales under the program.
